# Punkolink

> Punkolink (L7) is a layer 7 router for production traffic — a binary you run yourself or hand off to be operated for you.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#overview): What Punkolink L7 is, what it isn't, and where it sits in your stack.
- [Quickstart](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#quickstart): Get a Punkolink instance routing real traffic in under five minutes.
- [First Login](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#first-login): Securing the admin panel the first time you log in.
- [New Route](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#new-route): Adding your first route from the admin panel.
- [Cheat Sheet](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#cheat-sheet): The commands and config blocks you'll reach for most, in one place.
- [Alternatives](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#alternatives): Battle-tested open-source options, for when Punkolink isn't the right fit.

## Optional

- [Home](https://punkolink.com/): Marketing homepage and contact sales.
